# event trajectory

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventTrajectory`](gmeow-eventTrajectory.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTrajectory>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

The trajectory of a moving event — a parade, march, migration, or procession — describing its continuous space-time path. Reuses the [`gmeow:Trajectory`](../classes/gmeow-Trajectory.md) facility from the locations module. Non-functional: competing trajectory claims from different sources coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
